story.titleZh: 威廉姆斯说服塞恩斯签下多年续约合同
story.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯已与威廉姆斯签下一份多年期合同续约，将自己在F1的近期未来交给车队，尽管2026赛季开局艰难。
story.originalTitle: Williams convinces Sainz to sign multi-year extension
story.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz has signed a multi-year contract extension to commit his immediate Formula 1 future to Williams, despite a difficult start to 2026.
detailZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯（塞恩斯）已将其近期的F1未来托付给威廉姆斯车队，尽管2026赛季开局艰难，他仍同意了一份多年续约合同。
这位西班牙车手于去年初加盟威廉姆斯，因为他相信这支车队有能力充分利用本赛季的规则大改。
但成绩远低于预期，威廉姆斯的赛车因发布延迟、初始规格严重超重，以及缺乏在前列竞争所需的速度而深受其害。
竞争困境的严重程度，以及尽管在阿塞拜疆大奖赛带来一套重要新套件但本赛季仍难有转机的渺茫希望，加剧了外界对塞恩斯是否会继续坚守该项目的质疑。
对他来说，长期来看其他地方的明显选择包括奥迪——他在加入威廉姆斯之前曾与其沟通过——以及经历了更加艰难的2026赛季的阿斯顿·马丁。
不过，尽管他显然也在关注其他地方的车手市场情况，周三还是宣布了Sainz已同意一份新的多年合同，继续留在威廉姆斯。
合同的具体年限没有透露，但未来几年很可能会有选择权条款。
这份协议意味着，随着队友阿尔本也已在2027年续约，车队将在新赛季保留其两位车手。
虽然Sainz有时因威廉姆斯车队今年的困境而感到沮丧，但他表示，车队正在进行的改革所展现出的希望让他确信，这里仍然是他应该呆的地方。
“有很多理由留下来并和车队继续努力，”他说。
“首先，是因为组成这个大家庭的人们。我相信团队的力量能够取得成功，我认为威廉姆斯的人们拥有正确的才能、动力和热情，能把这支车队带回巅峰。
“幕后还有很多变化、投资和项目正在进行，这让我相信我们正走在正确的道路上。
“我们本赛季遭遇了挫折，但我们拥有卷土重来、变得更强所需的一切条件。”
塞恩斯表示，他与车队高层管理层（包括领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯）就本赛季出现的问题以及需要改进之处进行了“透明且坦诚”的对话。
他认为，至关重要的是要有一个“让每个人都能为自己的行为负责、以求改进的工作环境”。
他确信，如果威廉姆斯车队“专注于流程、注重细节并相信我们的直觉，我相信成绩自然会随之而来”。
车队领队James Vowles显然非常高兴能说服Sainz留队，因为失去他将对车队的前进努力造成重大打击，
“他是这支车队的领袖，我非常激动他能看到我们在持续重建过程中所拥有的可能性，”Vowles说道。
“不仅他的比赛技术和速度十分出众，他在幕后为追求高性能所做的工作也同样令人瞩目。”
detailEn: Carlos Sainz has committed his immediate Formula 1 future to Williams, after agreeing a multi-year contract extension despite a difficult start to 2026.
The Spaniard joined Williams at the start of last year because he believed that the squad was well-placed to make the most of this season’s regulatory overhaul.
But the results have fallen far below expectations, with the Williams car suffering from being late, being very overweight in launch spec and not having the pace needed to fight near the front.

The scale of the competitive struggles, and little hope of a turnaround this season despite a major new package coming for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, fuelled doubts about whether or not Sainz would stay committed to the project.
Obvious options for him elsewhere over the long term included Audi, which he had spoken with prior to joining Williams, and Aston Martin that has endured an even more difficult 2026 campaign.
But despite clearly keeping an eye on the driver market situation elsewhere, it was announced on Wednesday that Sainz had agreed a new multi-year contract to stay at Williams.
No specific length of the contract was detailed, but it is likely there there will be options over forthcoming years.
The deal means that, with team-mate Alex Albon having also extended in 2027, that the squad will retain both its drivers into the new season.

While Sainz has been left frustrated at times by Williams’ struggles this year, he says that signs of promise from changes being made at the team have left him convinced it remains the right place for him.
“There are many reasons to stay and continue to push with the team,” he said.

“First and foremost, because of the people who form this big family. I believe in the strength of the group in order to be successful, and I think the people at Williams have the right talent, motivation and passion to bring this team back to the top.
“There are also a lot of changes, investments and projects happening in the background that make me believe we are on the right path.
“We have hit a bump in the road this season, but we have all the right ingredients to bounce back and come back stronger.”

Sainz said that there had been some “transparent and honest” conversations with senior team management, including boss James Vowles, about what had gone wrong this season and what was needed to address things.
He felt it critical there was a “working environment in which everyone can take responsibility for their actions with a view to improving.”
He is sure that if Williams: “focus on the process, pay attention to the details and trust our instincts, I’m convinced the results will follow".
Team principal James Vowles is clearly delighted that he has convinced Sainz to stay, as losing him would have been a big blow to the squad in its efforts to move forward,
“He is a leader of this team, and I’m thrilled that he can see what’s possible as we continue to rebuild it,” said Vowles.
“It’s not just his race craft and speed that stand out, but the work he does behind the scenes in the pursuit of high performance.”
keyPointsZh: 塞恩斯于去年年初加入威廉姆斯，因相信车队能在新规则大改版中占据优势
威廉姆斯赛车因研发迟、发布版严重超重且缺乏竞争力而远低于预期
尽管阿塞拜疆大奖赛将迎来重大新套件，车队本赛季翻盘希望渺茫，一度引发外界对塞恩斯去留的疑问
keyPointsEn: Sainz joined Williams at the start of last year believing the team was well-placed for the regulatory overhaul
The Williams car has underperformed after being late, very overweight at launch and lacking the pace to fight near the front
Despite a major new package coming for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, doubts had grown about whether Sainz would stay committed

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
keyPointsEn: Pirelli won the 2025-2027 F1 tyre supply contract against a rival bid from Bridgestone, and its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after the FIA took up an option.
The FIA is set to launch a new tender process from 2029, with fresh competition expected to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.
